name: Paris (IDF)
author: JcPires
description: The entire Île-de-France region (Greater Paris, 12.3M inhabitants) in high-quality data. 3.6M OpenStreetMap buildings with foundation depths, tunnelling under the Seine (river bathymetry), and a realistic demand of ~7M daily trips derived from French census data. Includes special demand: airports (CDG, Orly, Le Bourget), universities (Paris-Saclay, Sorbonne, Nanterre…), landmarks (Louvre, Eiffel Tower, Versailles), Stade de France, Disneyland Paris, major malls and parks.
